popular.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
popular.plot: A full-time crimefighter protects a city that has forgotten who he is, while watching people from his past move on without him. As loneliness and strange changes in his abilities add to the pressure, he must face a dangerous new threat that puts the city and those he cares about at risk.

popular.title: The Odyssey
popular.plot: After a devastating war, a legendary king begins a long, perilous journey home. Along the way, he faces powerful gods, terrifying monsters, dangerous temptations, and difficult choices that test his cleverness, courage, and humanity, while his family struggles with his prolonged absence and uncertainty about his return.

popular.title: Matchbox the Movie
popular.plot: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

popular.title: Hope
popular.plot: In a remote South Korean village, local police investigate a mysterious creature causing chaos in the community. As fear and confusion spread, the investigation becomes entangled with human conflict, challenging what the villagers think they understand about the threat.

popular.title: Street Fighter
popular.plot: In 1993, two estranged martial artists are drawn back into combat when a mysterious fighter recruits them for a global tournament. As the brutal competition unfolds, a deadly conspiracy tests their uneasy partnership and forces them to confront difficult parts of their past.

popular.title: Animals
popular.plot: After the son of a mayoral candidate is kidnapped, the candidate and his wife have only a few hours to find the ransom. With most of their money tied up in the campaign, they must take desperate steps that bring hidden parts of their lives into view.

popular.title: Masterplan
popular.plot: A legendary thief recruits two young strangers to help steal a famous painting, then reveals an unexpected family connection. Thrust into a chaotic reunion, the new family must learn to work together—and tolerate one another—if they hope to pull off an ambitious heist.

popular.title: Runner
popular.plot: A former soldier and his unlikely partner must transport a vital medical delivery while a ruthless cartel pursues them. What begins as a simple courier job becomes a dangerous race against time, with mounting obstacles threatening their chance to reach a young girl in need.

popular.title: Other Mommy
popular.plot: A young girl forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home, where it looks uncannily like her own mother. This connection draws her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world, as the presence becomes part of her life at home.

popular.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
popular.plot: A young mother raising her daughter in the house where she grew up discovers she can enter a parallel realm inhabited by dangerous spirits. When she learns she can bring entities from that world into reality, she must confront a growing supernatural threat while protecting her family.

popular.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
popular.plot: Two climbers travel to Thailand to attempt a forbidden route across Mount Kwan, hoping to confront their fears. Thousands of feet above the ground, unstable paths, extreme exposure, and limited options turn the dangerous journey into a desperate fight to survive.

popular.title: Whalefall
popular.plot: After his father’s death, a young diver searches off the California coast for his remains, only to be swallowed by a massive sperm whale. Trapped inside with his oxygen running low, he must draw on lessons from his father as he struggles to find a way out.

popular.title: The Fix
popular.plot: Disillusioned after the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, battle-worn former intelligence operatives head to Tehran to pursue a score that could change their lives. As they try to make it happen, they also grapple with past mistakes and the desire to make amends.

popular.title: Sacrifice
popular.plot: At a lavish charity gala filled with celebrities and billionaires, a movie star facing an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her followers. As the evening spirals into chaos, the hostage and captors are drawn into an unpredictable journey that blurs the boundaries between performance, belief, salvation, and sacrifice.

popular.title: Digger
popular.plot: A powerful oil tycoon faces a frantic crisis after a disaster linked to his company threatens to unleash catastrophe. As he works with political leaders and scientists to respond, he must confront the consequences of his actions and the forces shaping the unfolding emergency.

popular.title: Resident Evil
popular.plot: A medical courier is caught in a terrifying outbreak during one chaotic night and must fight to survive as danger closes in. Far from a trained action hero, he faces increasingly frightening encounters while trying to make his way through the crisis.

popular.title: Toy Story 5
popular.plot: When a young girl becomes absorbed in a new tablet, her toys find it harder to hold her attention. The group faces a new challenge as they try to help her reconnect with playtime, navigating changing habits and the place technology has in a child’s life.

popular.title: The Social Reckoning
popular.plot: A young engineer teams up with a newspaper reporter on a risky effort to expose closely guarded secrets at a powerful social network. Their journey puts them in the middle of a high-stakes whistleblowing story.

popular.title: Sense and Sensibility
popular.plot: After their family loses its home, two sisters move to a distant relative’s estate and face the challenges of reduced circumstances. As each navigates romance and financial uncertainty, their contrasting temperaments shape how they respond to love and society’s restrictions.

popular.title: Buddy
popular.plot: A magical orange unicorn hosts a children’s television show while holding its young cast captive inside a surreal world. As the cheerful lessons grow increasingly disturbing, the children begin questioning their reality and searching for a way to survive their demented host.

upcoming.title: The Loud House Movie
upcoming.plot: A large family travels to Scotland, where they discover royal ancestry and move into a vast ancestral castle. Their exciting new surroundings bring family dynamics, musical moments, and an adventure that takes them far beyond their everyday life.

upcoming.title: Wicker
upcoming.plot: In a tight-knit fishing village, a social outcast asks a local craftsperson to create a husband from wicker. As she grows unexpectedly attached to the handmade companion, the relationship stirs gossip and jealousy, putting pressure on the community’s fragile sense of order.

upcoming.title: Klara and the Sun
upcoming.plot: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

upcoming.title: Coward
upcoming.plot: During the First World War, soldiers working behind the front line struggle to keep their spirits up. Inspired by war rhetoric, each person searches for a personal way to cope amid the pressures of conflict.

upcoming.title: La Gradiva
upcoming.plot: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

upcoming.title: A Talent for Murder
upcoming.plot: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

upcoming.title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
upcoming.plot: Gianina, a young Romanian chambermaid, works for a bourgeois family in Bordeaux and spends her evenings rehearsing a maid’s story with an amateur theater group. She cares for her employer’s son while her own daughter grows up far away in Romania, and as Christmas nears, the hope of reunion grows stronger.

upcoming.title: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz
upcoming.plot: This documentary traces the rise and lasting influence of an unlikely internet icon, from an anonymous teenager to a global symbol of fitness culture. It explores how his transformation shaped ideas about influencers, identity, and self-invention for a generation.

upcoming.title: BTS: THE RETURN
upcoming.plot: A globally celebrated music group reunites in Los Angeles to record a new album. This documentary offers rare access to their creative process, group dynamic, and fresh chapter as they work together in a new era.

upcoming.title: Moulin
upcoming.plot: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

upcoming.title: Species
upcoming.plot: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

upcoming.title: Breeder
upcoming.plot: A poodle breeder obsessed with genetic perfection makes an unsettling proposition to a young man who left university: she wants him to father children with her daughter. He must decide how to respond as the breeder’s fixation pushes ordinary boundaries.

upcoming.title: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back to the Beginning
upcoming.plot: A landmark farewell concert reunites pioneering heavy metal performers for a high-energy celebration of classic songs. The live event also features guest artists and other bands performing tributes and original material, creating a powerful salute to the genre’s enduring legacy.

upcoming.title: The Blood Countess
upcoming.plot: A powerful vampire and her maid pursue a legendary elixir and a book that could endanger their supernatural world. Chasing them are a determined police inspector, two vampire experts, an unconventional nephew, and his therapist.

upcoming.title: Free at Heart
upcoming.plot: A sheltered teen’s small-town routine is shaken when his family takes in another boy his age. As the two grow closer, they uncover a complicated family connection that strains trust at home and forces them to navigate intense feelings, secrecy, and the pressure of community judgment.

upcoming.title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
upcoming.plot: After an accident leaves a young man without his hands, his mother turns to radical technology in hopes of helping him recover. Their efforts unfold at the family manor, where the promise of restoration brings difficult choices and unsettling uncertainty.

upcoming.title: The Strange Little Cat
upcoming.plot: It is a Saturday in autumn, and Karin and Simon are visiting their parents and youngest sister Clara. This family gathering provides the occasion for a dinner together, at which other relatives appear over the course of the day. While the family members animate the apartment’s space with their conversations, everyday activities and cooking preparations, the cat and dog range through the various rooms. they too become a central element in this quotidian familial dance that repeatedly manifests stylized elements, disrupting any naturalistic mode of presentation. In this way, adjoining spaces open up between family drama, fairy tale and the psychological study of a mother.

upcoming.title: Wild Horse Nine
upcoming.plot: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

upcoming.title: Animol
upcoming.plot: Inside a young offender institution, a new arrival is thrown into a harsh world of gangs, loyalty, and constant threat. As a quiet connection forms with another inmate, their bond becomes a risky weakness in a place that punishes vulnerability.

upcoming.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
upcoming.plot: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

kids.title: Coco
kids.plot: A young aspiring musician struggles against his family’s generations-old ban on music. After a mysterious turn of events takes him to the vibrant Land of the Dead, he teams up with a charming trickster on a journey to understand his family’s past and find a way home.

kids.title: The Wild Robot
kids.plot: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot is stranded on an uninhabited island. As the robot learns to survive among wary animals, it forms an unexpected bond with an orphaned gosling and takes on the challenge of raising it in the wild.

kids.title: Inside Out
kids.plot: When an 11-year-old moves to a new city, her emotions try to help her adjust to a life away from familiar friends and routines. After two of them become lost in the reaches of her mind, they must find their way back while the others try to manage the upheaval.

kids.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
kids.plot: A weary Halloween figure discovers the wonders of Christmas and decides to bring the holiday’s cheer to a world built around scares. As the unusual plan takes shape, a thoughtful rag-doll companion worries about its consequences and tries to set things right.

kids.title: Forgotten Island
kids.plot: During their final night together, two high school graduates discover a mysterious portal leading to a fantastical island. When they learn that returning home could cost them every memory of their friendship, they race across the island to find another way back before they forget each other.

kids.title: Inside Out 2
kids.plot: As a teenager enters a new stage of life, her mind’s familiar emotions face an unexpected change when Anxiety arrives alongside other new feelings. At hockey camp, she navigates shifting friendships and the pressure to fit in, while the emotions try to understand how to guide her through it all.

kids.title: Toy Story 5
kids.plot: When a young girl becomes absorbed in a new tablet, her toys find it harder to hold her attention. The group faces a new challenge as they try to help her reconnect with playtime, navigating changing habits and the place technology has in a child’s life.

kids.title: Zootopia 2
kids.plot: After solving a major case, two rookie officers follow a new mystery that unsettles their animal-filled city. Their investigation takes them undercover into unfamiliar neighborhoods, where they must work through fresh challenges and test the strength of their partnership.

kids.title: Coyote vs. Acme
kids.plot: After another Acme product backfires during his pursuit of the Roadrunner, a determined coyote takes the corporation to court with help from a struggling billboard lawyer. Their case brings cartoon chaos, courtroom clashes, and a fresh challenge for the company behind his long-running disasters.

kids.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
kids.plot: Two Brooklyn plumber brothers are transported through a mysterious pipe into a magical world, where they are separated. One brother sets off on a fast-moving quest to reunite with the other, encountering colorful new places and familiar challenges along the way.
